text: Accepted Pop3Channel records the status before calling onStopRequest. Pop3Client passes final status to the URL listener, SetUrlState(false,status) and onDone before releasing the lock and marking the client free. State-file writing can replace the earlier status with NS_ERROR_FAILURE, so a stored request status must describe final completion rather than default NS_OK. The existing queue/lifecycle naming note is reused. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: POP3 request and URL completion report the actual final status
